label: Гарвард — разговорный
sample_dialogue: А вы слышали? Учёные Гарвардского университета установили: подопытные мыши размножаются гораздо лучше.
performance_prompt: A mature native Russian male voice in a medium-low register. Slightly muted, dry, lived-in and subtly weathered, with only faint smoky roughness. Clear and easy to understand. Natural conversational delivery at a steady medium pace, as if casually sharing an interesting fact with someone nearby. Serious, calm, understated, intelligent and mildly cynical. Not polished, not theatrical, not a narrator or announcer. Do not perform the joke or exaggerate emphasis. Use a short natural pause after the opening question; then continue smoothly and matter-of-factly.
